text_1044727654_copy.text:
Ready to work on problems that matter, and be trusted to help solve them?

Our Early Talent Programme gives students and graduates the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work, learn from experienced colleagues and gain exposure to different areas of the business from day one.

Whether you're passionate about science, healthcare, technology or business, you'll have the chance to make an impact while developing the skills and experience to shape your future career.

If you like big questions more than easy answers, you'll fit right in.

text.text: Our Early Talent programme runs across two very different businesses, so you can find the right fit for your interests and ambitions. You'll rotate in roles across our business, taking real ownership from day one.

text_660149018.text:
Therapeutics:

Discovering and delivering innovative medicines in areas like immunology, oncology, and neuroscience.

text_660149018_copy.text:
Aesthetics:

Shaping the future of medical aesthetics with world-leading brands and cutting-edge science.

item_1782992618711.text:
Market Access:

Discover how innovative medicines reach the patients who need them, through health economics, NHS policy and real-world value.

item_1782992646905.text:
Marketing:

Work alongside brand teams to bring our medicines to life — from campaigns and content to customer insight and market data.

item_1782992651954.text:
Customer Excellence:

Help shape how AbbVie engages with healthcare professionals. You'll explore data, tools and channels that make every customer interaction smarter.

item_1782992627810.text:
In-Field Sales:

Take AbbVie's story directly to clinicians and specialists across your territory. A full UK driving licence is required.

item_1782992913435.text:
PR & Comms:

In PR & Comms, graduates will help shape how Allergan Aesthetics is perceived by the outside world. From supporting media relations and managing social content to working on corporate communications and stakeholder engagement, you'll develop your storytelling and communications skills in a fast-paced, creative environment. This is a brilliant rotation for those who love crafting a narrative and understanding the power of brand reputation.

item_1782992920586.text:
In-Field Sales:

In this rotation, graduates will represent the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio directly with aesthetic clinics, practitioners, and healthcare professionals. You'll build strong customer relationships, understand the competitive landscape of the aesthetics market, and develop the consultative selling skills needed to thrive in this unique and exciting sector. A full UK driving licence is required for this rotation.

item_1782992929418.text:
Marketing & AMI:

In this rotation, graduates will support the marketing strategy for Allergan Aesthetics' iconic product portfolio. You'll work at the intersection of brand marketing and education, helping to develop campaigns and Allergan Medical Institute (AMI) initiatives that engage and inspire aesthetic healthcare professionals. Expect to flex your creativity, data skills, and passion for a fast-moving, trend-led category.

item_1782992941085.text:
Business Excellence:

Graduates in Business Excellence will work behind the scenes to make the commercial engine run smoothly. This rotation focuses on performance analytics, commercial planning, and process optimisation - giving you a bird's-eye view of how the business operates. You'll use data and insights to identify opportunities, track progress against key objectives, and support strategic decision-making across the Allergan Aesthetics business.

item_1764157488557.text:
A degree helps, but it's not the whole story. We hire for potential, not just polish. You'll thrive here if you're:

Curious: You ask questions, dig deeper, and enjoy learning fast

Bold: You're not afraid to challenge the status quo or share a fresh idea

Collaborative: You know the best work happens with (and through) other people

Analytical: You can turn complexity into clear thinking

Ready to lead: Whether that's a project, a moment, or a room

In addition, you must also hold a full UK driving licence and be able to commute to our Maidenhead Office (Therapeutics) and Marlow Office (Aesthetics).

item_1764157492515.cq:panelTitle: What you'll gain from joining AbbVie
item_1764157492515.text:
• A culture that has your back: We've placed in the UK's Great Place to Work Awards for the past 12 years.
  • Rotations that drive perspective: Try different parts of the business and find where you thrive
  • Real ownership from day one: Projects that shape strategy, not shadow it
  • Mentorship that matters: Coaching from leaders who've been where you are
  • A launchpad career: Potential to take on a permanent role in one of our business areas
  • Competitive salary and benefits: Plus modern offices designed for how people actually work

text_1721398848_copy.text:
Choosing where to start your career is about more than the role itself. It's also about finding an organisation where you can learn, grow and contribute to something meaningful.

At AbbVie, we're united by a purpose to make a remarkable impact on people's lives. Through our Early Talent Programme, you'll gain hands-on experience, develop valuable skills and work alongside colleagues who are passionate about what they do.

Watch to learn more about life at AbbVie and our global mission.

title_1905673451_cop.jcr:title: Our application process: what to expect

text.text: We want you to feel prepared and supported at every stage. Here's how it works, from first click to final offer.

item_1764157483483.text: Upload your CV and cover letter through our careers portal. Want a sneak peek into what we're after? Our CV prep guide is a good place to start.

item_1764157488557.text: If you're shortlisted, we'll invite you to a short call with one of our team. It's a two-way conversation. A chance for us to hear what drives you, and for you to ask the questions you really want answered about the programme.

item_1764157492515.text: Next, you'll record answers to a set of structured questions in your own time. There's no trick to it, we're looking for authenticity, not a rehearsed pitch. Tell us your story, in your words.

item_1782466304642.text:
If you progress, you'll join us in person at our Maidenhead office for an assessment day. You'll take part in:

  • A short presentation on a topic we share in advance (so you can prepare properly)
  • A competency-based interview built around our behaviours
  • A group exercise You'll also get to meet some of the team and see where you could be working.

item_1782466311066.text: After your assessment day, we'll take time to review everything carefully. Whatever the outcome, you'll hear from us, with feedback, next steps, and (we hope) an offer.

text_901131163.text: We want every candidate to feel able to do their best at every stage. If you need adjustments, whether that's extra time, a different format, accessibility support, or something we haven't thought of, just let us know when you apply, or at any point in the process. We'll work with you to make it happen.
